versions.name: Camp C.S. Klaus

features.note: A river canoe trip runs in alternate years within the COPE program.
A caving experience on camp property, alternating yearly with the canoe trip.
A tower with two rappelling heights, an inverted wall, a chimney climb, and a dozen routes.
Low and high ropes courses for older Scouts.
A purpose-built wild west town of targets.
BASE Camp, Beginning Advancement Skills for Eagle, a Brownsea-style patrol programme.
The camp nature centre houses live snakes, fish, and other animals.
Daily afternoon games including volleyball, soccer, lacrosse, and basketball.
The IMPACT area blends STEAM and Eagle-required merit badges.

versions.summary: Northeast Iowa Council Scouts BSA resident summer camp set in a 200-acre wooded valley near Colesburg, offering 45+ merit badges, a COPE/climbing tower, aquatics on Lake John Deere, and a BASE Camp program for new Scouts.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
